implementation.change: Move depth indentation from inline declarations to the CSS recipe. Folder padding remains 8 + depth × 12 px; files add 16 px.

limits: The source recordings retain original control-openhands playback timing, with no editorial speed change. CLI summary duration is rounded; exact container duration, frame count and capture counters are recorded for every original. Video is evidence of the control sequence, not a finer-grained timing instrument.
Coverage is standalone Local Canvas in Neutral, Light+ and DeepSea at 1440×1000 desktop and 390×844 phone. No Cloud, ACP, all-five-theme or arbitrary embedded-host pass is claimed.
Editorial labels and title cards are distinct from real app viewports. Actual UI pixels, including normal displayed temporary paths, are unretouched; public JSON omits local machine paths.
Initial After captures with the expanded Getting started checklist are superseded. Final selected sources use the real UI to collapse the checklist before replay.
Real conversation titles, Thinking content and elapsed labels differ naturally between bounded DeepSeek turns. No pixel-identity claim is made.

In all six plugin-phone states, the After run-cache path wraps into four lines versus three Before. It adds 16 px above the tree. Raw row-Y differences are retained; relative indentation, row width/height/X, colors, selection, file content and controls match.

The 30 fps film duplicates frames from the 15 fps source recordings. It adds no motion samples and makes no finer timing claim. The full workspace-phone clips are available as originals; the short film selects the plugin-phone clips.
